name: استخراج الإشارات والخطة لكل شمعة
rewrites:
buySignal := buySignal or chTriB or chSniB
sellSignal := sellSignal or chTriS or chSniS

buySignal := buySignal or chTriB or chSniB
sellSignal := sellSignal or chTriS or chSniS
buySignal  := buySignal  and allowLong  and not sfBlock
sellSignal := sellSignal and allowShort and not sfBlock
// ── تصدير الخطة لكل شمعة وللجهتين، ليصير مسح التبريد خارج المتصفح فورياً ──
_xE = close
[_xBTb, _xBSb] = f_sy999_source_plan(1, _xE, m1SelectedSourceCode, longTypeNow)
[_xPTb, _xPSb, _xPMb, _xPDb] = f_dae_exit_plan(1, _xE, _xBTb, _xBSb, longTypeNow)
xTgtB = math.max(30.0, _xPTb)
xStpB = math.min(_xPSb, xTgtB + 20.0)
[_xBTs, _xBSs] = f_sy999_source_plan(-1, _xE, m1SelectedSourceCode, shortTypeNow)
[_xPTs, _xPSs, _xPMs, _xPDs] = f_dae_exit_plan(-1, _xE, _xBTs, _xBSs, shortTypeNow)
xTgtS = math.max(30.0, _xPTs)
xStpS = math.min(_xPSs, xTgtS + 20.0)
xBuy  = buySignal  ? 1 : 0
xSell = sellSignal ? 1 : 0
